scope: Read-only reconciliation of the M523 broken-reference UI clean-session boundary

sourceReread.inMemoryGuard: An existing in-memory projectProposalSession produces a distinct blocker before persisted storage is loaded; M523 reached the later aggregate check, so this branch was not the observed blocker.

priorOutcomeUnknown.conclusion: M520 may have persisted an applying proposal session before timeout; unchanged project bytes do not prove session absence. M523 preserved the uncertainty and did not inspect browser storage.

conclusion.exactBlocker: Persisted project proposal-session status is the attributable boundary; the exact stored status remains unknown without an in-app redacted preflight.
conclusion.safeNextBoundary: M525 code-only redacted preflight using the existing typed loader, reporting only MISSING, PASS plus lifecycle status, or BLOCKED plus validation code.
